# FI Digital UAE

> AI Agent Architects & Zoho Ecosystem Experts for UAE Enterprises. Dubai-headquartered, Australian-founded. We build AI-powered business automation using Zoho, n8n, Claude, Gemini, and LangChain for mid-market and enterprise businesses across the UAE with bilingual (Arabic + English) solutions.

## Digital Workers & AI Agents

- [WhatsApp Sales Agents](/digital-workers/whatsapp-sales-agents) - Bilingual WhatsApp AI agents that qualify leads and process voice notes in Arabic and English
- [Real Estate Agents](/digital-workers/real-estate-agents) - AI agents that qualify property inquiries, score leads, and sync to Zoho CRM
- [Finance & Procurement Agents](/digital-workers/finance-procurement-agents) - Automated AP/AR, VAT filing, bank reconciliation integrated with Zoho Books
- [Customer Service Agents](/digital-workers/customer-service-agents) - Multilingual support automation across WhatsApp, email, and chat via Zoho Desk
- [HR & Onboarding Agents](/digital-workers/hr-onboarding-agents) - End-to-end employee onboarding, leave management, and HR query handling

## Platform & Technology

- [Zoho Agentic AI](/platform/zoho-agentic-ai) - Enterprise Zoho implementation with AI agent layer using Zia, n8n, Claude, and Gemini
- [n8n Workflow Orchestration](/platform/n8n-orchestration) - Self-hosted enterprise workflow automation connecting 400+ applications
- [Custom AI Development](/platform/custom-ai-development) - LangChain and Python-based custom AI agents with RAG, memory, and tool use
- [Data Analytics](/platform/data-analytics) - Real-time dashboards and predictive business intelligence
- [Multilingual LLM](/platform/multilingual-llm) - Arabic-English AI language processing
